name: FuturesTrend
description: Multi-asset trend-following. Two strategies co-exist in this project as source files: (1) v3.1 baseline (main.py, ETF universe, Donchian + SMA50, fixed 33% sizing, Sharpe 0.07 / PSR 0.007% over 2015-2024, backtest b869c19d1320401e3c3a84ae7037abc4); (2) Carver #13 port (main_carver13.py, 19 continuous futures, six EWMAC horizons, trend-only blend — carry disabled c.1107 see README, vol-regime multiplier [0.5, 2], breadth multiplier clip [1, 2] — sign-invariant effective breadth of absolute magnitudes / INVERSE concentration, NOT Carver FDM, REPAIR-3 c.1109 + REPAIR-5 c.1111 + REPAIR-7 c.1113 semantic correction after adjoint po-2025 preflights, cap +/-20) per Carver 2023 and QuantConnect research article #15989 (Derek Melchin, 2026-01-02). CAREFUL: QC Cloud executes ONLY main.py. A project can hold extra source files, but only main.py is the algorithm entry point, so main_carver13.py is never run from this project. Measuring the Carver #13 arm (issue #15549) therefore required a SEPARATE QC project (FuturesTrend-Carver13, 36488678) whose main.py carries the port; running it here would overwrite the baseline entry point and destroy the comparison arm. Measured 2026-09-13 on that separate project: compile BuildSuccess 0 errors, backtest b7b7217ee540757f3d78167ab9eeea2e Completed over 2763 tradeable dates with totalOrders 0 (Sharpe 0 / CAGR 0% / MaxDD 0% / PSR 0% / $0.00) — the port emits no trade, so the #15549 verdict is INCONCLUSIVE (non-functional arm, not a measured edge), see README.
